name: Thomas Topping
bioAdditions: Savage (vol. 4, p. 255) records that Thomas Topping of Milford joined the Milford church 'with his w. Emma in 1640' and 'had Elnathan, bapt. 2 Aug. of that yr. and James, 12 Feb. 1643' (S1). That fixes Capt. Elnathan's baptism, 2 Aug 1640. Savage also notes the 20 Oct 1666 marriage contract with Mary, widow of Timothy Baldwin, the third wife Lydia (widow of John Wilford) by June 1678, and the 5 Oct 1686 Branford deed of his Southampton lands to sons Elnathan and James (S1, S2).

sources.citation: James Savage, A Genealogical Dictionary of the First Settlers of New England, vol. 4 (1862), p. 255, entry TAPPAN/TOPPING, Thomas of Milford
